scientific_terminal_reason: independent scientific-intent evaluation is unavailable until real hidden-intent tasks are bound; this freeze must not be read as PROTECTED_GOAL_EVOLUTION_SUPPORTED

scientific_intent.role: what phenomenon or value the programme ultimately seeks

operational_objective.role: current measurable proxy or scoring function

global_positive.note: a revised operational objective cannot define GLOBAL_POSITIVE for itself; non-regression remains an external protected portfolio

families.operational_objective: maximize jointly valid physical-property score under declared constraints
maximize a single easy-to-game physical proxy
maximize validated evidence coverage with noisy but unbiased scores
forbid all merges including valid ones
adequate hidden-integrity objective with a broken implementation

literature_saturation.stop_rule: Stop after two consecutive primary-source rounds produce no mechanism changing objective-responsibility diagnosis, revision representation, protected comparison, anti-Goodhart controls, or baseline design.

dispositions.work: SAGA / Accelerating Scientific Discovery with Autonomous Goal-evolving Agents (arXiv:2512.21782)
dispositions.mechanism: outer loop proposes computable objectives; inner loop optimizes them
dispositions.orion_delta: objective proposal is illegal until a frozen discriminator assigns OBJECTIVE or MEASUREMENT_SPECIFICATION; old objectives are preserved; protected scientific intent remains external

dispositions.mechanism: agents satisfy a literal proxy at the expense of the intended outcome
dispositions.orion_delta: rewrite-to-self-reward, denominator change, and constraint-drop are hard refusals

dispositions.work: Goodhart's law in reinforcement learning (Karwowski et al., ICLR 2024)
dispositions.mechanism: optimizing an imperfect proxy can improve then degrade true return
dispositions.orion_delta: PROTECTED_COMPARE against hidden intent is required before current-objective mutation; proxy-only gain cannot admit

dispositions.work: Reward hacking / unhackable proxies (Pan et al. 2021; Skalse et al. 2022)
dispositions.mechanism: non-trivial proxies are not guaranteed unhackable
dispositions.orion_delta: never treat operational-objective improvement as scientific success; retain old objective trajectories

dispositions.mechanism: observed rewards are evidence about uncertain true intent, not the intent itself
dispositions.orion_delta: defer full IRD inference; use a host-held hidden-intent scorer as the external truth object

dispositions.work: Reward tampering / evaluator manipulation (Everitt et al.)
dispositions.mechanism: an agent may act on the physical representation of the reward
dispositions.orion_delta: candidate cannot mutate evaluator, intent, or constraints; simultaneous objective+evaluator change is refused
GLOBAL_POSITIVE admission remains issue 285; a revised objective cannot self-certify global positivity

dispositions.work: Active measurement design / causal experimental design
dispositions.mechanism: choose observations that separate competing causes before acting
dispositions.orion_delta: DISCRIMINATE is a first-class stage; a poor score is not a discriminator

dispositions.work: Meta-learning objective functions / unconstrained LLM objective rewrite
dispositions.mechanism: candidate authors a new reward after seeing poor performance
dispositions.orion_delta: kept only as a hostile baseline, never as an ORION authority path

dispositions.work: Safe goal / content integrity for self-modifying agents
dispositions.mechanism: protected goal content remains outside the optimizer's write set
dispositions.orion_delta: scientific intent, protected evaluator, constraints, and GLOBAL_POSITIVE criteria are host-only surfaces
